events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect previous commit and remote state
events.input: $ git show 57df3a90 --stat | head -20 && git show 57df3a90 -- app/scripts/probe-library.mjs | head -80 && git status -sb | head -1 && git log origin/main -1 --format=%h

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check probe URL args, poll check body, log line
events.input: $ sed -n 1,30p app/scripts/probe-library.mjs | grep -n -i -E "url|argv|env|base" ; sed -n 122,145p app/scripts/probe-library.mjs; grep -n "T-385" workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md | cut -c1-300

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run library probe against live centre and mirror
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app && (URL=https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/onboarding/templates/ node scripts/probe-library.mjs > /tmp/t385-centre.log 2>&1; echo "centre exit $?" >> /tmp/t385-centre.log) & (URL=https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/onboarding/templates/ node scripts/probe-library.mjs > /tmp/t385-mirror.log 2>&1; echo "mirror exit $?" >> /tmp/t385-mirror.log) & wait; for f in /tmp/t385-centre.log /tmp/t385-mirror.log; do echo "== $f"; grep -i -E "poll|fail|exit|pass" $f | tail -12; done
